subject: Mutual Action Plan — signature window & procurement cutover
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call, I'm attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the NovusAI pilot. High-level summary:

- Target pilot start: 2026-07-06
- Target contract signature: 2026-06-25 (Novus procurement asked for an in-line deadline)
- Key dependencies: Novus legal review (2 weeks), PO issuance, SOC2 evidence handoff for data controls

Next steps I captured from the conversation:
1) We (Redwood) update MAP responsibilities and circulate redlines (that's attached as MAP_v1_Novus_Redwood.xlsx).
2) Novus to confirm procurement signature window and any internal blackout dates.
3) If legal needs more time, we agree on a rolling milestone that preserves the pilot start date OR adjust start accordingly.

Marissa — can you own the contract draft and liaise with our legal ops? Logan — can you pencil in the dedicated endpoint pool sizing so we can include capacity milestones?

Alicia — please confirm that 6/25 is realistic for signature and whether procurement needs the PO before DocuSign.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
From: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novusai.com>, Legal <legal@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

Thanks, Dylan — great recap and the MAP looks good as a starting point. A couple of clarifications from my side: 

- Procurement is asking for signature by EOD 2026-06-24 to get into the June contract batch; if we miss that we move to July billing cycle which delays pilot kickoff.
- Our legal team typically needs ~10 business days for standard SaaS reviews; they flagged two items to watch: data residency language and indemnity limits.
- For PO flow: procurement prefers to issue the PO before signature where possible (we can do PO + signature, or PO issued after but that can take an extra 5 business days).

I've looped in Procurement and Legal on this thread. Procurement — can you confirm whether 6/24 EOD is feasible for Novus?

Alicia
Head of AI Integrations, NovusAI
alicia@novusai.com
From: Procurement Team <procure@novusai.com>
To: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

Hi all,

Quick note from procurement: 6/24 EOD is feasible if the contract is in carrier doc form by 6/18 so we have time to route the PO and internal approvals. If you need the PO up front, we can request an expedited PO but that requires a signed procurement request by 6/17. Normal timeline to issue a PO after signature is ~5 business days.

We also need a filled Novus_PO_Form.pdf (attached) with cost line items and billing contact to process quickly.

Thanks,
Novus Procurement
procure@novusai.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novusai.com>, Legal <legal@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

Thanks for the details, Procurement and Alicia. Couple action items from Redwood's side to hit the 6/24 signature window:

- Marissa: can you prioritize the initial contract draft and aim to get carrier doc over to Novus legal by 2026-06-17 EOD? I'll mark this a high-priority for the deal.
- Logan: can you provide the dedicated endpoint sizing and an initial cost line (for the PO) by 2026-06-15? Procurement needs that to pre-fill Novus_PO_Form.pdf.
- Stephanie: please prepare a standard one-time credit clause in case we need a short performance SLA credit for the pilot (Procurement asked about uptime SLAs).

Proposed adjusted MAP milestone table (short):
- 2026-06-15: Redwood provides cost line and capacity numbers (Logan)
- 2026-06-17: Redwood delivers carrier contract to Novus legal (Marissa)
- 2026-06-18: Novus confirms carrier doc receipt; procurement starts routing PO
- 2026-06-24: Target signature (Procurement asks EOD)
- 2026-07-06: Pilot start

If legal pushes timelines, we should agree to a contingency: maintain pilot start if PO is issued and a soft hold is set on the signature. I want to avoid losing the June billing cycle if possible.

Dylan
--
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>, Procurement Team <procure@novusai.com>, Legal <legal@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

All — I'll take point on the contract. Plan:

1) I'll push the carrier draft (MAP_v1_redlines_novus.pdf) to Legal by 2026-06-17 as requested. It will include the standard Redwood data residency clause but I've added a brief alternative for Novus in case they require explicit EU-only storage (we should know if that is necessary this week).
2) I'll flag the indemnity bucket for redline and propose a capped liability that aligns with our standard enterprise terms.
3) Stephanie — appreciate the SLA credit language; please include a short paragraph I can propose to Legal so we can avoid prolonged back-and-forth.

Also attaching the updated MAP with responsibilities column filled (MAP_v1_redlines_novus.pdf). I recommend we lock the internal owners to minimize delay: 
- Contracting: Marissa (Redwood) / Alicia (Novus)
- Capacity sizing: Logan (Redwood) / Novus eng (TBD)
- Billing / PO: Stephanie (Redwood) / Novus procurement

I will circulate the carrier doc to Novus legal by the 17th and chase daily until signature. If procurement can provide the PO form now, Logan and I will pre-fill the cost lines so Procurement can expedite issuance.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Alicia Rivera <alicia@novusai.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@novusai.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft and next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. Confirming Novus can aim for a 2026-06-24 signature if Redwood hits the 6/17 carrier doc and we get the pre-filled PO by 6/15. Procurement — we will start routing the approval chain once the PO is in and prioritize the June batch.

I also requested Legal to triage the indemnity/data residency notes and will send any substantive redlines by 6/19 at the latest. If all goes to plan, we are aligned on the MAP milestones and target close date of 6/24–6/25.

I'll update internally and ping you if anything changes. Thanks,
Alicia
